end.summary:
Practised naming small animals found in soil and leaf litter.
Earthworm, ant, beetle, millipede, woodlouse, and termite were discussed.
Pihu asked whether earthworms are insects and suggested butterflies and caterpillars.
Pihu repeated that all small crawling things are insects; this was not corrected before stopping.
end.parentNote: Asha practised animals found in soil and leaf litter, using a damp spot and moving leaves aside as examples. Pihu noticed ant-like insects after the leaves were moved and asked useful questions about earthworms and mud. The mix-up that earthworms and all small crawling things are insects was still present when the lesson ended. At home, sort picture cards into “insect” and “not an insect,” placing earthworm in the second group.
